subject: Re: M-Theory numerics — decision on the June scan
body:
Bruno, Yara,

Decision after this morning's check-in: we run the large scan as planned on our cirrus-tpu week starting 06-22, but we cut the scan volume 20% so the float64 polish pass fits inside the reservation with half a day of slack. Better a complete, polished catalogue of a slightly smaller region than a partial sweep of the full one.

For the 06-26 OKR lock I'll write the key result as "extended critical-point catalogue, polished residuals < 1e-9" without committing to a point count. Yara, please send me the two headline numbers you're confident in by 06-24 evening — that gives me a day of buffer.

Farah's loader work is done and she rolls off this week as planned.

Thanks all — strong quarter for the weirdest project in my portfolio.

Anders
